source: AS 1170.4-2007 (Amdt 2): site sub-soil classes Ae-Ee (4.2), spectral shape factor Ch(T) (6.4, Table 6.4), the equivalent static method V = kp Z Ch(T1) Sp/μ W (6.2), T1 = 1.25 kt hn^0.75 (6.2.3), Fi by Wi hi^k (6.3), μ and Sp of the systems (Table 6.5), the earthquake design categories (2.2, Table 2.1), drift (5.4.4)

Ae.description: Class Ae: strong rock (UCS > 50 MPa, Vs > 1500 m/s)

Be.description: Class Be: rock (UCS 1-50 MPa, Vs > 360 m/s)

De.description: Class De: deep or soft soil (period above 0.6 s)

Ee.description: Class Ee: very soft soil (more than 10 m with Vs below 150 m/s)

sources.siteClasses: AS 1170.4 4.2 (site sub-soil classes Ae-Ee) and Table 6.4: Ch(T) = Ch(0) + slope T to 0.1 s (modal analysis; the equivalent static method takes the plateau, staticPlateau), min(c/T, plateau) to 1.5 s, c'/T² beyond: Ae 0.8 + 15.5T, 0.704/T <= 2.35, 1.056/T²; Be 1.0 + 19.4T, 0.88/T <= 2.94, 1.32/T²; Ce 1.3 + 23.8T, 1.25/T <= 3.68, 1.874/T²; De 1.1 + 25.8T, 1.98/T <= 3.68, 2.97/T²; Ee 1.1 + 25.8T, 3.08/T <= 3.68, 4.62/T²; S = Ch(0) for the peak ground acceleration a_h = Z S
sources.designSpectrum: AS 1170.4 6.2.2: V = [kp Z Ch(T1) Sp/μ] Wt (the method shapeFactors with R standing for μ, kμ = μ); 7.2: the modal design spectrum Cd(T) = kp Z Ch(T) Sp/μ; Table 3.1 note: kp Z at least 0.08
sources.designSpectrum.shapeFactors.performance: AS 1170.4 Table 6.5(A)-(B): Sp = 0.77 for μ up to 2 (1.25, 1.5, 2), 0.67 for μ 3 and 4 (linear between 2 and 3: no system has such μ)
sources.periodCoefficients: AS 1170.4 6.2.3: T1 = 1.25 kt hn^0.75, kt 0.11 steel moment frames (Ct 0.1375), 0.075 concrete moment frames (0.09375), 0.06 eccentrically braced steel frames (0.075), 0.05 other structures (0.0625)
sources.systems: AS 1170.4 Table 6.5(A) (concrete, masonry) and 6.5(B) (steel): the structural ductility factor μ (in R) and the structural performance factor Sp; Cd = μ/Sp the drift amplification of 5.4.4 (displacementFactor); Ω0 1.0: no overstrength factor in AS 1170.4 (SAEngine practice). The μ of the walls, dual and masonry rows are uncertain: to be checked against Table 6.5
sources.designCategories: AS 1170.4 2.2, Table 2.1: earthquake design categories in SAEngine's slots B = EDC I, C = EDC II, D = EDC III; SAEngine takes the row of buildings 12-50 m high (IL1 EDC I, IL2 and IL3 EDC II, IL4 EDC III) for every height and Z: EDC I of low buildings at low kp Z (simple static method, Section 5) and EDC III of buildings over 50 m are not chosen automatically (the equivalent static method of Section 6 is used for all)
sources.requiredDetailing: AS 1170.4 has no detailing level by category: the system's own detailing (μ) applies (ordinary in every category)
sources.allowableDrift: AS 1170.4 5.4.4: interstorey drift at the ultimate limit state (elastic × μ/Sp) at most 1.5 % of the storey height
sources.minimumScale: AS 1170.4 7.2? : modal base shear scaled to at least 90 % of the static (uncertain: to be checked)
sources.accidentalEccentricity: AS 1170.4 6.6: the earthquake actions applied at ±0.1 b from the centre of mass
sources.pgaFactor: AS 1170.4: Z is the peak ground acceleration on rock for 1/500 (a_h = Z Ch(0))
sources.verticalFactor: AS 1170.4 5.4.? / 6.? : no general vertical component (cantilevers and long spans of EDC III only, not covered): 0
sources.liveShare: AS 1170.4 6.2.2 seismic weight Wt = G + ψE Q, ψE = 0.3 (AS/NZS 1170.0 Table 4.1)
sources.dampingCorrection: AS 1170.4 gives Ch(T) for 5 % damping only: no damping correction
